component.name: Moondrop Control
水月雨耳机控制
component.summary: Control MOONDROP Bluetooth headphones from the Plasma panel
在 Plasma 面板上控制水月雨蓝牙耳机

description.p: A KDE Plasma 6 widget and command line tool for MOONDROP Bluetooth headphones, talking to them directly over the RFCOMM control channel.

ul.li: Noise cancelling modes: off, cancelling and transparency
A graphical five band parametric EQ with AutoEq / EqualizerAPO import
LDAC, LC3 and LHDC switches, three step DAC gain, multipoint
Per earbud and case battery levels
Automatic connection and reconnection as the headphone comes and goes

description.p: No root and no bluetoothctl are required: the applet uses an AF_BLUETOOTH socket as the ordinary user.

Verified on MOONDROP EDGE (firmware 1.4.0) and Moondrop Nekocake (firmware 1.0.0). Profiles for other models are written from public protocol documentation and are marked as unverified in the user interface.
